title: Explainer reporter: measureAt can loop with a document that mutation-observes <html>
reason: F4's paper emulation writes an inline style on <html> twice per post; a document whose MutationObserver watches <html> attributes and changes layout in response loops the reporter until the per-width budget latches, then a later growth at that width leaves a stale frame with an inner scroll (probe: 300 posts <12s, maxTop 374); none of docs 25-33 nor the /explain template does this; fix: cap measureAt per width separately from the posting budget, correct the header comment
trigger: the /explain template or any framed document gaining a MutationObserver, or an explainer seen churning or stale after load
dropped_reason: Moot after P30.S25: the measured box, frame print slicing and height reporter are retired (P30.REVIEW)
